provenance.origin: Authored by script in Blender; no third-party, downloaded, kit, AI-service or commercial-game content. The r001 look (palette, motifs) is imitated, no r001 mesh or texture is reused.

recipe.method: Barbarian: heavy skeleton fit bulked up 9%, bare painted torso and arms, fur mantle and kilt, greataxe on weapon_socket. Procedural meshes, atlas and skin weights from Art/rig-pilot/cast/scripts (build2.py, cast_batch2.py) on the r001 skeleton; the nine shared hand-keyed clips of Art/rig-pilot/r001/scripts/clips.py plus the tenth, Brace (brace.py); one per-class override of the shared Melee clip, Melee_Barbarian (30 frames), authored on the shared skeleton by overrides.py with a small IK over rigkit's FK (the ranger's bow, whose string nock is skinned to hand.R, is authored there too); no external motion data
recipe.approved_reference: Gate 1 decision on #140 (25-bone skeleton); #147 pilot contract (Art/rig-pilot/r001/README.md); #150 batch 2 design calls by the graphics lead (class looks, Brace clip, Rim 1.6 and Fill 1.25)

parameters.units: metres, +X forward, Z up, foot pivot at origin
parameters.lods: LOD0 with clips; LOD1 and LOD2 as separate skinned glbs without clips
parameters.clips: ten: Idle, Walk, Melee, Ranged, Cast, Hit, Downed, Death, Recover, Brace (24 frames, 0.8 s, not a loop); plus the override action Melee_Barbarian in this glb (0 to 30 frames, starts and ends on Idle frame 0)

settings.importer: glTF skeletal mesh; reuse the existing shared skeleton (SKEL_Humanoid from the #147 fighter import); no new skeleton and, apart from the one override clip named under override_clip, no clips are imported for this character
settings.lods: LOD1/LOD2 glbs imported as LOD meshes of the same skeletal mesh
settings.animations: the shared A_Humanoid_* clips are reused (nine from #147, A_Humanoid_Brace from #150 batch 2); the other clips baked into this glb are not imported (the baked shared Melee is not used for this class: its override replaces it)
settings.material: MI_* child of M_DiceRollTheme with rim and fill terms; glow from vertex alpha only

override_clip.source_file: Art/sk-hero-barbarian/r001/SK_Hero_Barbarian.glb (the LOD0 export, the same file the mesh is imported from)
override_clip.skeleton: /Game/DnDDiceRoll/Theme/Characters/SKEL_Humanoid (the shared one: the glb is imported onto it, the sequence is checked to be on it, nothing else of that import is kept)
override_clip.policy: import once: an existing destination package is kept and never replaced or deleted; the staging import is deleted after the sequence is moved
override_clip.theme_entry: ClassRigs[Barbarian].Overrides[Melee] (data, UDiceRollTheme / FDiceRollCharacter::Overrides); a class with no entry plays the shared clip
